title: Programming projects with ChatGPT instructional feedback
summary: Students submit programming-project work and receive instructional feedback generated through ChatGPT. The feedback intervention addresses code quality and project work, and the study evaluates its effect on student learning and motivation compared with the course's usual feedback process.

sources.title: An Investigation into ChatGPT-Based Instructional Feedback on Programming Projects

assessment.summary: Develop a programming project and use ChatGPT-generated instructional feedback on the submitted work.
